competences: The learner distinguish a starting point from a duration.
The learner use since and for correctly in given sentences.
languageCompetence: Pronounces, reads, spells and uses correctly: since, starting point, duration, present perfect.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to distinguish a starting point from a duration.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to use since and for correctly in given sentences.
priorKnowledge: Learners tell time and recognise hours and years as units of time.
materials: Time-expression cards: 9:00 a.m., an hour, four hours
Sentence chart comparing since and for

steps.content: Learners tell time and recognise hours and years as units of time. Key words: since, starting point, duration, present perfect
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher displays time-expression cards: 9:00 a.m., an hour, four hours and links the chart to the prior knowledge: Learners tell time and recognise hours and years as units of time. The teacher pronounces the lesson vocabulary, checks learners’ reading, and introduces using since.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall familiar words, read the displayed key words aloud, and explain what they already know about the topic.

source.quote: Since is used when a point of time from which an action began is given

steps.content: Since and for: Since introduces the point of time when an action began. For introduces the length of time an action has lasted. A starting point and a duration give different time information.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: Since introduces the point of time when an action began. For introduces the length of time an action has lasted. A starting point and a duration give different time information. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "Complete the source sentence with since or for: The boy has been crying ___ 9:00 a.m." Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: Since is used when a point of time from which an action began is given

steps.content: Example 1: The boy has been crying since 9:00 a.m. The starting point is 9:00 a.m. The boy’s crying began at that time.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: The boy has been crying since 9:00 a.m. The starting point is 9:00 a.m. The boy’s crying began at that time. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "Complete the source sentence with since or for: The baby has cried ___ an hour." Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: The boy has been crying since 9:00am

steps.content: Example 2: The baby has cried for an hour. An hour is a length of time. The sentence gives a duration.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: The baby has cried for an hour. An hour is a length of time. The sentence gives a duration. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "Complete the source sentence with since or for: They have played ___ four hours." Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: The baby has cried for an hour

steps.content: Example 3: They have played for four hours. I have not seen my mother for two years. Four hours and two years are durations.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: They have played for four hours. I have not seen my mother for two years. Four hours and two years are durations. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "Complete the source sentence with since or for: They have played ___ four hours." Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: They have played for four hours

steps.content: Complete the source sentence with since or for: The boy has been crying ___ 9:00 a.m. Complete the source sentence with since or for: The baby has cried ___ an hour. Complete the source sentence with since or for: They have played ___ four hours.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher gives the following sourced text-based exercise: Complete the source sentence with since or for: The boy has been crying ___ 9:00 a.m. Complete the source sentence with since or for: The baby has cried ___ an hour. Complete the source sentence with since or for: They have played ___ four hours. The teacher checks learners’ written answers for meaning, spelling and punctuation, using this key: since for for
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer individually in their books, use full sentences when required, read selected answers aloud, and correct spelling or punctuation after feedback.

source.quote: The boy has been crying since 9:00am

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher revisits these questions: Complete the source sentence with since or for: The boy has been crying ___ 9:00 a.m. Complete the source sentence with since or for: The baby has cried ___ an hour. Complete the source sentence with since or for: They have played ___ four hours. The teacher checks whether learners have met the objectives, explains any remaining errors using the source text, and assigns the final exercise item for correction.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners explain their answers with evidence from the text, read corrected sentences aloud, and note the final item for homework.

source.quote: They have played for four hours

assessment: Check oral reading and written responses to these questions: Complete the source sentence with since or for: The boy has been crying ___ 9:00 a.m. Complete the source sentence with since or for: The baby has cried ___ an hour. Complete the source sentence with since or for: They have played ___ four hours. Mark meaning, spelling, sentence structure and punctuation against the displayed source models.
homework: Complete or correct the following source exercise item, writing the answer neatly: Complete the source sentence with since or for: They have played ___ four hours.
